# Zoi

> Zoi is a modern dining restaurant on the 4th floor of JD Hi Street Mall, Mahatma Gandhi Main Road, Hindpiri, Ranchi, Jharkhand, India. Asian, Continental and North Indian cuisine, a full bar, and a room that changes from bright and easy at lunch to warm and lively after dark. Open daily 12:00 PM – 12:00 AM.

- Phone: +91 77799 74888
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/lifeatzoi
- Reservations: https://www.zoiworld.com/#reserve

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.zoiworld.com/): the room, the ambience, and a reservation form.
- [Food menu](https://www.zoiworld.com/menu): soups, salads, small plates, dim sum, pizza, hand-made pasta, Oriental, Thai, grills, Indian mains, biryani, breads, desserts and healthy plates, with prices in INR.
- [Bar menu](https://www.zoiworld.com/menu/bar): signature and classic cocktails, shots, long drinks, spirits, wines, beers, mocktails, milkshakes, tea, coffee, juices and matcha, with prices in INR.
- [Careers](https://www.zoiworld.com/careers): apply to work at Zoi.

## Facts

- Address: 4th Floor, JD Hi Street Mall, Mahatma Gandhi Main Road, Hindpiri, Ranchi, Jharkhand, India
- Hours: daily, noon to midnight
- Cuisine: Asian, Continental, North Indian
- Private dining: Privée, a lounge for up to 40 guests; the whole venue can be booked for larger celebrations
